status: Independent qualitative exterior review; no installed acceptance

primary_assembly_reference.reviewed: Actual image independently viewed; paired ducts, air cleaner, bracket and body references; no dimensions inferred

comparison_method: Owner driver/passenger photos viewed separately; actual full canonical/v3 GLB renders at high front and front-side orthographic angles. No image compositing, camera calibration, pixel measurement or metric registration.

findings.topic: Air cleaner and paired inlet ducts
findings.owner_observation: Large rectangular driver-side airbox with paired corrugated ducts to throttle body dominates foreground of driver view.
findings.mesh_observation: Neither canonical nor v3 includes the airbox/paired ducts; front throttle mouths remain exposed.
findings.action: Integrate a source-supported body-mounted airbox/duct/bracket assembly after vehicle anchors and endpoints are established; retain existing separate air-cleaner candidate limitations.
findings.required: Shared pump/throttle/front-body datum, airbox mounting bracket/fender/radiator-support anchors, duct endpoint axes and lengths. Existing exact-year diagram190226466 supports decomposition.
findings.scope: Engine/body interface; source topology known, body placement unknown

findings.topic: Large coolant/heater hoses and wiring overlay
findings.confidence: high visible absence; exact routes unknown
findings.owner_observation: Large radiator hose crosses front; prominent heater hoses and loom/cable runs bridge engine and body, obscuring much of the manifold/accessories.
findings.mesh_observation: Short metal takeoffs and selected modeled leads do not reproduce these large cross-engine routes; both scenes look unusually bare.
findings.action: Declare engine-side hose/loom boundaries, model source-supported connected routes after body-side endpoints and clips are established.
findings.required: Accessible owner side/front views with shared landmarks; hose endpoint IDs/diameters and supported clamp/clip locations. Avoid copying photo curves as exact3D.
findings.scope: Some vehicle-side hoses intentionally outside current engine scope; visual mismatch still real

findings.topic: Accessory carrier silhouettes and missing belt
findings.confidence: high missing belt; medium contour/placement suspicion
findings.owner_observation: Accessories sit in visually dense cast supports with belt/shroud context; much of their rear support is hidden.
findings.mesh_observation: Open geometric braces/plates and separated clean cylindrical units remain conspicuous; no continuous drive belt links visible pulley grooves in either render.
findings.action: Finish source-matched common carriers/belt routing before changing individual accessory centers; use existing accessory source studies and belt-label evidence.
findings.required: Orthogonal donor front view with crank/pump/accessory axes and belt plane, rear carrier surfaces and actual bracket identity. Photos alone do not justify shifting compressor or alternator.
findings.scope: No new clearance-driven accessory shift proposed

findings.topic: Upper intake and valve-cover exterior contour
findings.confidence: medium qualitative contour; no calibrated size conclusion
findings.owner_observation: Owner intake has rounded casting transitions and a broad molded/cast central cover; runners partly hidden by hoses. Valve-cover cap/vent and shoulder regions have smooth irregular forms.
findings.mesh_observation: Repeated runner sweeps, straight plenum walls and regular cover edge appear more geometric and exposed. Current trim/color emphasizes edges.
findings.action: Compare orthographic silhouette and section landmarks of identified intake/cover specimen; refine visible contour without disturbing verified attachment ports.
findings.required: Plan and two side specimen views with scale and fixed bolt/port datums; current perspective does not establish width, height or22mm lean correction.
findings.scope: Candidate contour study only until measurements; do not claim wrong engine based on one oblique view

findings.owner_observation: Fan shroud/radiator, battery, reservoirs, booster and firewall frame the actual engine and hide lower/front geometry.
findings.mesh_observation: Isolated engine floats without those neighbors, making fan/accessories and lower block appear much more prominent.
findings.action: Provide a clearly scoped engine-bay context view when body/radiator reference frames exist, while retaining isolated engine for learning.
findings.required: Vehicle body/radiator-support anchors and overall compartment registration; do not add fake collision-free context shells.
findings.scope: Truck-system work, not evidence engine dimensions are wrong

findings.owner_observation: Owner engine is weathered metal/rubber with subdued contrast and visible age; existing lead/hoses colors vary.
findings.mesh_observation: Uniform clean gray, green, gold and black teaching colors make individual parts stand apart.
findings.action: Offer source-consistent material appearance separately from educational system coloring after geometry priorities; do not hide geometry errors with texture.
findings.required: Existing authorized photos suffice for qualitative palette; exact material/paint identity remains unverified.
findings.scope: Presentation; not a geometry acceptance substitute

canonical_vs_v3: Both share major external missing context and top silhouette; internal timing/crank/valvetrain corrections and limited sealing/lead changes do not solve exterior identity. V3 remains uninstalled; no active newer water-pump tube/carrier trial substituted.
uncertainty: Photos rotated in stored files; orientation judged from radiator/firewall landmarks, not filename alone.
No exact accessory displacement, casting dimension or scale error inferred from perspective.
Observed absence in rendered scope is not a claim part is absent from the actual truck.
Owner reports no known modifications; this is not proof all parts are original.
